description: This is a Java class named ModuleConfig that defines configuration properties related to system modules, including scheme, host, port, URI, environment, and additional configurations. It contains getter and setter methods for each property.

classes.name: ModuleConfig
classes.description: A Java class representing configuration parameters for a system module, encapsulating properties like scheme, host, port, uri, environment, and additional configs, with accessor methods.

methods.name: getScheme
methods.description: Returns the scheme (e.g., http or https) of the module configuration.

methods.name: setScheme
methods.description: Sets the scheme (e.g., http or https) of the module configuration.

methods.name: getHost
methods.description: Returns the host name for the module configuration.

methods.name: setHost
methods.description: Sets the host name for the module configuration.

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Returns the port number for the module configuration.

methods.name: setPort
methods.description: Sets the port number for the module configuration.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Returns the URI associated with the module configuration.

methods.name: setUri
methods.description: Sets the URI for the module configuration.

methods.name: getEnv
methods.description: Returns the environment setting for the module configuration.

methods.name: setEnv
methods.description: Sets the environment setting for the module configuration.
